# package rolestore

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/go-opcua/server/rolestore"
```

Package rolestore persists the managed RoleSet of a server (OPC 10000-18, server.WithRoleManagement): the roles AddRole added (§4.2.2) and the Identities, Applications, ApplicationsExclude, Endpoints and EndpointsExclude of every role whose configuration can change (§4.4.1). A [Store](#type-store) is the server.RoleSetStore of server.WithRoleSetStore: the server writes each change of its RoleSet in one atomic write, whatever makes it (the RoleSet and Role Methods of §4.2.2, §4.2.3 and §4.4.5 to §4.4.10, a Write of ApplicationsExclude or EndpointsExclude, and the server.RoleSet methods), and restores what it wrote when it starts again.

It is built on package uafx/fxstore, the persistence of the library, as packages server/pushstore and server/pubsubstore are: a Store is one [fxstore.Domain](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-opcua/uafx/fxstore#Domain) (namespace "roles") on an [fxstore.Store](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-opcua/uafx/fxstore#Store) backend, by default an [fxstore.FileStore](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-opcua/uafx/fxstore#FileStore) in a directory of its own ([OpenDir](#func-opendir)). Each write is one Domain.Apply with the next revision. A write with an unknown outcome fences the store: later writes are refused until Settle has found what the backend holds and, where the write landed although the server did not apply it, has written the roles the server has back. A server therefore never restarts with a change it did not apply.

The records, by key in the namespace:

	root      the roles in their order: a format byte (1) and the keys
	          of their records, a count and the keys, every count and
	          length an unsigned varint of encoding/binary.
	role/<h>  a role: a format byte (1), a flags byte (1: added by
	          AddRole, 2: ApplicationsExclude, 4: EndpointsExclude),
	          the namespace URIs of its NodeId and of its BrowseName
	          (each a length and the bytes) and, in the OPC UA Binary
	          encoding (Part 6 §5.2), its NodeId in namespace 0, the Name
	          of its BrowseName, its Identities
	          (IdentityMappingRuleType[]), Applications (String[]) and
	          Endpoints (EndpointType[]).

\<h> is the first 16 bytes of the SHA-256 of the namespace URI and the NodeId of the role, in hexadecimal. The namespaces of a role are mapped to the NamespaceArray of the server when it is loaded, so that a role keeps its NodeId, "a Server shall persist the identifierType and identifier NodeId elements of a Node as well as the Namespace Uri which the namespaceIndex NodeId element references" (OPC 10000-3 §5.2.2), when its namespace has another index; a namespace the server does not have fails the load (ErrNamespace).

The records hold the rules that grant the roles, SecurityAdmin included: who may change them may grant themselves any role. A FileStore creates its directory 0700 and its files 0600, and refuses a directory the group or others may write. An application that needs encryption or integrity protection at rest wraps the fxstore.Store it passes to Open.

## Variables

```go
var ErrClosed = errors.New("rolestore: closed")
```

ErrClosed is returned by a closed Store.

```go
var ErrNamespace = errors.New("rolestore: a namespace of the stored roles is not in the server")
```

ErrNamespace reports a stored role in a namespace the server does not have: the role cannot be restored as it was written.

### type Store

```go
type Store struct {

	// Close closes backend

	// restore, when not nil, is the state the store must hold again: that
	// before a write with an unknown outcome, which the server did not
	// apply.

}
```

Store is the store of the managed RoleSet of one server. It implements server.RoleSetStore. It is safe for concurrent use; its writes are serialized.

#### func Open

```go
func Open(ctx context.Context, s fxstore.Store, o Options) (*Store, error)
```

Open opens the store on the backend s, which holds nothing else: the namespace "roles" must be the only one in it. It fails when s cannot be loaded, belongs to another owner, was written by a newer version, or holds records that do not decode (fxstore.ErrCorrupt). Close does not close s.

#### func OpenDir

```go
func OpenDir(ctx context.Context, dir string, o Options) (*Store, error)
```

OpenDir opens the store in the directory dir with an fxstore.FileStore, creating it if missing. The directory belongs to the store: it holds the lock file and the data file of the FileStore and nothing else. Close closes the FileStore.

#### func (Store) Close

```go
func (s *Store) Close() error
```

Close closes the store, and the backend of OpenDir. Writes after Close fail with ErrClosed.

#### func (Store) LoadRoleSet

```go
func (s *Store) LoadRoleSet(_ context.Context, namespaces []string) ([]server.Role, error)
```

LoadRoleSet returns the stored roles with their NodeIds and BrowseNames in the namespaces of namespaces, nil when the store holds none. A namespace that namespaces does not have fails with ErrNamespace. The roles belong to the caller.

#### func (Store) Settle

```go
func (s *Store) Settle(ctx context.Context) (bool, error)
```

Settle resolves a write with an unknown outcome: it establishes what the backend holds (fxstore.Domain.Settle) and, when the write landed, writes the roles before it back. It returns true when the store accepts writes again. Every write settles first, so an application may leave Settle to the next change of the RoleSet or run it with a backoff.

#### func (Store) Status

```go
func (s *Store) Status() fxstore.DomainStatus
```

Status returns the state of the domain of the store: its revision and whether it is fenced.

#### func (Store) StoreRoleSet

```go
func (s *Store) StoreRoleSet(ctx context.Context, roles []server.Role, namespaces []string) error
```

StoreRoleSet makes roles, their NodeIds and BrowseNames in the namespaces of namespaces, the stored roles in one atomic write of the records that change. It settles the store first. An error wraps fxstore.ErrNotCommitted when nothing of roles is durable; any other error is an unknown outcome, which fences the store until Settle.
